rows.proof: The FY2022 general fund appropriations, pages 28-32, 82 departments and 132 line items. FOUR identities the page states about itself, and all four close. (1) Every department returns available less expended less encumbered as its balance to revenue. (2) All five columns sum across the five pages to the GRAND TOTAL printed on p32 -- 45,416,024.49 appropriated and available, 44,297,537.94 expended, 364,285.44 encumbered, 754,201.11 balance to revenue. (3) The twenty-one amounts marked `fwd` sum to the 316,972.56 the page's own legend prints against `fwd - forward from FY 2021`. (4) The two amounts marked `srt` sum to the 11,453.48 printed against `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer`, and no amount is marked `rft` against a printed 0.00. Line items are transcribed beneath each department total and are NOT summed, because a department's `fwd` is folded into its appropriated column. THE ONE EXCEPTION IS PRIOR YEAR EXPENSE, whose total row prints 8,019.70 appropriated against 8,319.70 available: its 300.00 forward is carried as a row of its own so the column still foots.
